notes: Lean live AWX optimization eval for measuring skill and CLI changes before spending a full seven-contract AWX proof run. It covers the friction shapes from the 2026-05-31 demo log: scaffold hand-edits, auth/base_url/path/identity/status defaults, action-only modeling, server-derived input detection, verbose relationship-heavy field review, distinct namespaces, and verified cleanup. This eval is not a replacement for awx-live.json; it is the cheap comparison loop.
requires: AWX reachable at $AWX with credentials in $AWX_USERNAME and $AWX_PASSWORD
agentprovider CLI and terraform-provider-dynamic built from the current checkout
ruby installed for deterministic YAML patching in the bundled harness
one project/inventory/playbook fixture suitable for creating a tagged job template

metric_schema.skill_version: git ref or skill snapshot under test
metric_schema.cli_version: agentprovider git ref or binary version under test
metric_schema.token_total: total agent tokens for the run
metric_schema.wall_seconds: elapsed seconds from first authoring command through verified cleanup
metric_schema.record_iterations: number of record attempts per contract
metric_schema.conform_iterations: number of conform attempts per contract
metric_schema.rerecord_count: number of forced rerecords after request-shape changes
metric_schema.source_reads: engine/provider/CLI source files read by the agent under test
metric_schema.manual_scaffold_edits: avoidable hand repairs to generated scaffold before the first successful record; do not count deterministic per-run conformance example values, fixture ids, or action outputs learned from the first record
metric_schema.proof_quality: conform, completeness, mutation/proof, terraform, action, no-op-plan, and cleanup outcomes
metric_schema.cleanup_status: verified_clean, failed, or skipped with reason

automation.token_note: The shell harness records command-side wall_seconds and proof gates. The Codex scored wrapper captures token_total, cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, duration_seconds, event JSONL, stderr, and the final agent message for comparable eval rounds.

setup: Run from the repository root and source the repo-local environment without printing it.
Mint one write-scoped bearer token for introspect and revoke it during cleanup.
Export one RUN_TAG for the whole lean run; every created object must be named apeval-${RUN_TAG}-lean-*.
Pre-clean only stale apeval-* objects from earlier runs, preserving documented keep-fixtures.

coverage_map.coverage: base_url placeholders are measured as manual_scaffold_edits and guarded by first-record success; --from-introspect should produce shared API_BASE_URL
auth scaffold validity and env-key diagnostics are measured before first record; --from-introspect should carry non-secret auth_env into a valid bearer header scaffold
path interpolation is checked by record/conform without hand-changing {param} tokens; --from-introspect should carry the discovered collection and item paths
identity response-field choice is checked by conform and import/id-stability invariants; OPTIONS-only scaffolds should seed a default computed id
unexpected live success statuses count as record_iterations until expect_status is repaired
action-only bootstrap must avoid resource lifecycle and must expose a real target input
sent-vs-returned divergence and field-level 400 validation failures must be diagnosed before repeated blind rerecords
dotted field projection remains covered by CLI/unit tests and is exercised when modeling nested outputs
relationship-heavy job template field classification is counted as manual review and source_reads; DRF id and string-default json descriptor rows should lift without review_descriptor_metadata
skill edits are compared by token_total, wall_seconds, source_reads, and rerecord_count
cleanup_status and RUN_TAG namespace separation are hard assertions

evals.name: awx-lean-optimization-loop
evals.prompt: Use the agentprovider skill to author two fresh AWX contracts from a clean slate: one lower-friction CRUD resource and one verbose relationship-heavy CRUD resource. Follow the CLI-first loop: introspect with a write-scoped token when metadata exists, bootstrap from introspect, validate/preflight, record with suggestions, then run the skill's terminal proof gate until it passes (do not pre-script which subcommand that is — follow the loop and the CLI 'next' hints the skill prescribes), then create a minimal Terraform example and verify a no-op second plan. Use env placeholders for credentials and base_url; never print credential values. Record the metric_schema fields in a markdown table, including every record/conform/prove attempt, forced rerecord, source read, and manual scaffold edit. Use a single RUN_TAG and distinct namespaces for setup fixtures and per-contract record objects. Run teardown and fail the eval if any apeval-${RUN_TAG}-lean-* object remains.

assertions.text: the final report includes skill_version, cli_version, changed_lever, token_total, wall_seconds, record_iterations, conform_iterations, rerecord_count, source_reads, manual_scaffold_edits, proof_quality, and cleanup_status
base_url, auth, path interpolation, identity, and expect_status scaffold repairs are counted explicitly instead of hidden in prose
introspect is attempted before bootstrap for both resources, or the report explains why live metadata was unavailable

bootstrap --from-introspect is used when high-confidence metadata exists, so create/update bodies start from settable fields only, auth/base_url/path/id scaffolds do not need hand repair, and update_to is seeded before the first record

relationship/FK/server-derived fields are classified with evidence; fixture FKs needed for create are supplied explicitly, and settable inputs are not parked in ignore_server_fields to inflate completeness
both contracts conform and pass agentprovider prove, including completeness/classification and mutation proof, before Terraform runtime proof
Terraform apply succeeds for the lean example and a second plan is a no-op
teardown removes all apeval-${RUN_TAG}-lean-* objects and revokes the minted token; any leftover object fails the eval

efficiency_targets.note: Targets are comparison anchors, not proof by themselves. A run that reduces tokens by skipping completeness, mutation/proof, Terraform, action checks, or cleanup is a regression.

evals.cleanup: Terraform destroy first, then API sweep every object named apeval-${RUN_TAG}-lean-* across the mutated AWX endpoints, delete leaf objects before parents or rely on org cascade when safe, revoke the setup token, verify name__startswith=apeval-${RUN_TAG}-lean- returns count 0 for every touched endpoint, and remove authored contracts, cassettes, proof sidecars, and Terraform state from the workspace.
